githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 8 adds Discord Activities, Apply to Join for servers that review new members, role icons and gradient role colours, an @time timestamp picker and forum post mentions. It also animates deleted and edited messages, shows who's in voice when you hover a server, and matches embeds and buttons to Discord's colours.

## Activities

- Added Discord Activities: start one from a voice call, or from the + menu in a text channel or DM. Play it inside SakuraCord, or join one someone else is running. Activities started in a text channel or DM dock above the chat, with a sidebar row to return to them or leave.
- Added the Activity shelf, with Recents, Promoted badges and a details page, along with Discord's launch, join, leave and end sounds.
- Added cards for Activity invites and launch messages with Play and Join buttons, and an Activity icon on channels where one is running.
- Added support for Activity commands such as /wordle and app buttons such as Wordle's Play now!
- Activities keep keyboard input while focused, and stop playing when you leave them.

## Joining servers

- Added Apply to Join for servers that review new members. An invite or a server profile opens the server's application form, with short answer, paragraph, multiple choice and rules questions.
- Added a Pending Applications folder to the server list. Selecting an application shows whether it is awaiting review or denied, with the moderator's reason, alongside a preview of the server. You can withdraw, reapply, view your submitted answers or open an interview there.
- Added live approval and rejection: an approval shows a welcome and opens the server, starting onboarding when the server has it.
- Added rules screening: servers that only ask new members to agree to their rules show the same form. If you close it, the chat offers Complete in place of the composer.

## Messages and composer

- Added an @time picker to the composer and message editor. It turns phrases such as "in 5 minutes" or "friday 5pm" into a Discord timestamp in any format, and relative timestamps count live.
- Added forum posts and threads to # suggestions, including titles with spaces using #"…".
- Added animations for deletions and for edits made elsewhere: a deleted message fades out while the messages below slide up, and an edited message eases to its new height.
- Improved the contrast of Markdown link syntax and URLs in the composer.

## Servers and roles

- Added role icons beside names in the chat, member list, profiles and reply headers, and gradient role colours on names.
- Added a role-coloured glow when hovering a name. Avatar decorations now play when you hover any message in a group.
- Added who's in voice to the server hover label, with up to five avatars, and a Muted line for muted servers.

## Embeds and links

- Changed embed cards, link previews and message buttons to Discord's colours, borders and corner radii, tinted by gradient themes.
- Added image grids for posts that send several images under one card. Embed author, title and description text was restyled, and footer timestamps show "Yesterday at" and similar.
- Fixed quotes pasted from X splitting into separate lines.

## Settings and fixes

- Added Timeline settings to turn off message hover actions and the scroll-to-bottom button.
- Fixed the Dock badge counting mentions in deleted channels, which could leave a badge that nothing in the app showed.
- Fixed the emoji button showing blank in the composer and message actions on macOS 27.2.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-7...v0.1.7-Beta-8](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-7...v0.1.7-Beta-8)
discordAnnouncement:
**Discord Activities, Apply to Join and role icons 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Play Activities like Wordle inside SakuraCord from a call, a text channel or a DM, with Discord's shelf, invite cards and sounds
- Apply to servers that review new members, track applications in a Pending Applications folder, and complete rules screening without leaving the app
- Role icons and gradient role colours, with a glow when you hover a name
- Type @time to turn phrases like "friday 5pm" into a timestamp, and mention forum posts with #
- Deleted and edited messages animate instead of jumping, and embeds and buttons now use Discord's colours
- Hover a server to see who's in voice, plus new Timeline settings and fixes for the Dock badge and the emoji button on macOS 27.2
